description: Every trade agreement and preference scheme in an importing country's tariff (free trade agreements, customs unions, GSP and DCTS tiers, US special programs): id, official title, type, parties, signing date and the origin countries it covers. With partner (an origin country) or agreement (an id from get_tariff), also the rules of origin and the official links. Tariffs: gb (the UK), eu or an EU member state (de, fr, it, es, nl…; its import VAT applies), us (the United States) or in (India). Agreements are directional: these are the preferences for imports into the destination.

agreement.description: One agreement: its id (e.g. "eu-gb-tca", "gb-in-ceta") or words of its title.

destination.description: Importing country (required, or give importer): gb (the UK), eu or an EU member state (de, fr, it, es, nl…; its import VAT applies), us (the United States) or in (India). Names work too ("United Kingdom", "Germany").

partner.description: Only agreements covering this origin country (ISO code or name).

name: list_trade_agreements

origins.description: Origin countries the tariff gives the preference to (first 40).

rulesOfOrigin.description: With partner or agreement: the rules of origin.

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

caveat.description: The tariff figures are not a customs ruling; who makes the final determination.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

title: List trade agreements and preference schemes
